title: REquesting feedback for my (WIP)frame pulling tools. This is not an ad.
author: Yenii_3025
selftext:
(edit: reddit won't let me post it for some reason? I removed the link and might put it in the comments if thats whats throwing err's)  
  
As I was working on a game I needed somthing to pull frames from ai video. thought I'd try anti-grav as my agent after the i/o conference thing and made this. 



I'll never sell this. I just want to perfect it and get better and using AI and Ui,UX design. 

All the 'cards' work like this (the number on the list corresponds to the card\[window\] on the page): 

1. uploaded your video, trim your start/stop time
2. pick the number of frames you want to pull
3. Fk with the Background keying (background remover) you should always use a neon green background (until your subject is close to green) 
4. Adjust sprite sheet # of columns and rows. 
5. Review the Extracted walk (or any other animation, need to change this title lol) frames 
6. Really you're going to jumping back and forth between the preview window here and card 5. Fiddle with it until you've got the right animation.
7. Set up the correct pixel size for your frame, name it before exporting. Download and ENJOY. 

Give me feedback. Either here or I have a feedback button. Might even think of adding a comment section.
